description: Apply a switch config document (the format get_swos_config exports) to a SwOS switch. Plans every change against the switch first; dryRun defaults to true. Writes only the endpoints that change: the VLAN table grows first (new VLANs and members), then the per-port settings (VLAN, isolation, storm and flood control), port names/negotiation/enabled, LAG and SNMP, then the table shrinks (removed VLANs and members), then system — so no port loses its VLAN mid-apply. Refuses management changes (address, allow-from) unless includeManagement is true, and any plan that would cut a linked port off (its untagged VLAN moved or dropped, a trunk losing tagged VLANs or becoming an access port, a forced VLAN, a port that starts filtering VLANs, the port disabled, renegotiating, isolated from another linked port or moved in or out of a LAG, every linked port dropped from allow_from_ports; only risks the plan introduces) unless acceptLockoutRisk is true. All six endpoints are snapshotted before a real apply, so rollback_change restores the previous state; the result names any endpoint whose snapshot failed, and says so when none was recorded. A document that moves management to another VLAN (allow_from_vlan) and changes a port's VLAN settings or the VLAN table's membership at the same time is refused, because that cannot be written in a safe order (sys.b goes last and cuts the session): apply the VLAN changes first, then the move. `snmp.community` may reference only the secrets bound to the switch (its `secrets` list in routers.yaml); a switch without a list may reference none.

acceptLockoutRisk.description: Apply a plan whose warnings show a linked port being cut off (its VLAN, untagged traffic, link, isolation or LAG changing). Refused unless this is true; a dry run shows the warnings without it.

config.description: The switch config: a YAML document (as text) or the same structure as an object. `version: 1`, then any of `system`, `ports`, `vlans`, `snmp`; only the settings it names are changed. `snmp.community` may be `${NAME}`, replaced by the server's MIKROMCP_SECRET_<NAME> value; no other field may reference a secret.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Plan and show every change without writing to the switch.

includeManagement.description: Allow changes to how the switch is reached: address acquisition, static IP and the allow-from settings. Refused unless this is true.

pruneVlans.description: When the config has a `vlans` list, remove VLANs the switch has but the list does not.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: apply_swos_config
title: Apply SwOS Config
